title: OpenAI just open-sourced GPT-4 and nobody is talking about it

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Why is the open-sourcing of GPT-4 generating so little public reaction compared to earlier releases?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: GPT-4’s open-source version lacks key capabilities like fine-tuning and full API access, limiting immediate use.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Without guardrails, this could enable misuse in deepfakes, misinformation, and unauthorized surveillance.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are developing open-source alternatives with safety layers and community moderation to prevent abuse.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where open models are paired with ethical frameworks could democratize AI without sacrificing safety.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The real test will be whether open access fuels innovation without compromising societal trust.

video_cue: A split-screen showing researchers coding on open-source AI and a community debate on ethical AI use.
